scenario: [LNRE.6] `regex: false` reaches only regex literals and their evaluation: ordering and interpolation are unaffected, and a runtime built with RE2 loads the artefact normally. A `regex: false` program gates on `i.label > "M"` and logs the label. "Z" passes (Z > M); "A" fails the ordering. One message, "Z". A compiler that refused the program, or a runtime that refused the artefact for its `regex` setting, logs nothing.
rules_ds:
use default:
    regex: false

schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    label: String mutable

rule hit:
    Item i where i.label > "M"
->
    log info "{i.label}"
